name: agent-watch
description: A live pane of what every agent in the session is working on right now.

autoOpenWindow.title: Open the agents window by itself
autoOpenWindow.description: Opens the agents window by itself the first time two or more agents are working in a session, without taking the keyboard from the window you are typing in. Off, the window opens only when you type /agent-watch gui.

narrator.title: Plain-words narrator in the agents window
narrator.description: While the agents window is open, a small model (Haiku) writes each agent's card in plain words: what it is doing, how far along it is (an estimate), and what you can do about trouble. It runs only on a plan that does not pay per call (your Max plan), at most one call per agent per 20 s and 400 calls a session; its use is shown at the foot of the window. Off, the cards use plain rules and no model is called.
